items.t: Applauded the passage of a bill suspending Ohio's gas tax and diesel tax for 90 days.
items.q: Ohio Senator Bill Reineke (R- Tiffin) applauded the passage of a bill suspending Ohio's 38.5 cent per gallon gas tax and 47 cent per gallon diesel tax for 90 days.

items.t: Is focused on creating a strong business climate that enables both employers and employees to thrive.

items.t: Said that a job leads to a career and that training a student for a job is our responsibility.
items.q: “It is really important to recognize the needs of the workforce while at the same time fulfilling student purpose,” said Reineke. “A job leads to a career, and training a student for a job is our responsibility.”

record.t: Was elected by his Senate colleagues as President Pro Tempore for the 136th General Assembly.
